mapper.select: SELECT A.BILL_ID AS billId , A.PROJ_ID AS projId , A.BILL_TITLE AS billTitle , A.BILL_AMT AS billAmt , A.TAX_BILL_DT AS taxBillDt , A.PAY_DT AS payDt , A.IS_PAID AS isPaid , A.ACTUAL_PAY_DT AS actualPayDt , A.BILL_REMARK AS billRemark , B.PROJ_NM AS projNm FROM TB_BILLING A LEFT JOIN TB_PROJECT B ON A.PROJ_ID = B.PROJ_ID WHERE A.BILL_ID = #{billId} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_BILLING WHERE DEL_YN = 'N'
AND BILL_TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')

SELECT P.PROJ_ID AS projId , P.PROJ_NM AS projNm , IFNULL(C.CONT_AMT, 0) AS totalAmt , (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(BILL_AMT), 0) FROM TB_BILLING WHERE PROJ_ID = #{projId} AND DEL_YN = 'N') AS totalBilledAmt FROM TB_PROJECT P LEFT JOIN TB_CONTRACT C ON P.CONT_ID = C.CONT_ID WHERE P.PROJ_ID = #{projId}
SELECT BILL_ID AS billId , BILL_TITLE AS billTitle , BILL_AMT AS billAmt , TAX_BILL_DT AS taxBillDt , IS_PAID AS isPaid FROM TB_BILLING WHERE PROJ_ID = #{projId} AND DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY BILL_ID ASC
